notes:
Polish across badges, collections, and the title page.

- **A gold watched medal.** Finishing something now stamps a gold medal on its
  cover — and not just shows: movies, documentaries, and whole seasons and series
  get it too. It shows up in **Recently Added** as well, and hovering any badge
  tells you what it means.

- **Collections are their own shelf.** Collections now live in their own
  **Collections** section at the top of the library list and on their own page —
  no more choosing "TV Show" or "Anime" when you make one. A freshly-made
  collection shows in **Recently Added** with its badge.

- **Movies & documentaries, tidied.** The runtime now sits next to the rating
  instead of floating over the poster, and a finished film earns the watched
  medal like everything else.

- **Mark watched updates everything, instantly.** Marking a title, season, or
  episode watched (or un-marking it) now refreshes every screen on the spot — the
  library, Home, and Recently Added — with no manual refresh.

- **Clearer buttons on the title page.** Play, Start over, Mark watched, Add to
  collection, and Edit are a little bigger with crisper icons, and **Mark
  watched** now wears a medal.

- **Plural library names** everywhere — TV Shows, Movies, Documentaries,
  Collections.
